fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-09-27 at approximately 01:15, it was reported that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 12,000 was withdrawn. Lakshmi Raman submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000082. Venkat Palanisamy (mobile 9000000134) was named as a possible person of interest. Manoj Karuppasamy (9000000054) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Call detail reference; Mobile phone record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim was allegedly induced to approve a collect request on a UPI app.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, shopping complex, night, witness, mobile number, phone records, suspect
